nodes.description: Constant address of StabilityBoardProxy (0x4686...) used by the setup script to call addSigners/removeSigners.

Constant 100, page size for the UI helper read functions.
Deployer becomes the first and only signer at construction time; emits SignerAdded.
Signer signs a script; updates Script state/signCount and promotes to Approved once quorum is reached.
Executes an Approved script via delegatecall, marking state Failed/Done; the core reentrancy-relevant function.
Cancels a New or Approved script; only callable by the contract itself (via an approved multisig script).
Adds signers to the multisig; only callable via a script executed by the contract (msg.sender == address(this)).
Removes signers from the multisig; only callable via a script executed by the contract; cannot remove last signer.
Abstract quorum predicate implemented by derived contracts.

edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the key into the isSigner authorization mapping.
The constructor makes msg.sender (deployer) the first signer and owner of the multisig.
sign() reverts unless isSigner[msg.sender] is true.
execute() reverts unless isSigner[msg.sender] is true.
cancelScript() requires msg.sender == address(this).
addSigners() requires msg.sender == address(this).
removeSigners() requires msg.sender == address(this).
sign() reads isSigner to authorize the signer and records signedBy entries.
execute() reads isSigner to authorize the executor.
addSigners() reads and sets isSigner entries.
removeSigners() reads and clears isSigner entries.
getAllSigners() reads isSigner to report the active flag.
Constructor writes isSigner[msg.sender] = true.
Constructor pushes the deployer into allSigners.
Constructor initializes activeSignersCount to 1.
getAllSignersCount() returns allSigners.length.
getAllSigners() iterates over allSigners.
addSigners() pushes new signers into allSigners.
checkQuorum reads activeSignersCount to derive the quorum threshold.
checkQuorum performs the unchecked division activeSignersCount / 2.
The signersCount argument is compared against the quorum threshold.
Abstract checkQuorum receives the signature count used to decide approval.
addSigners() executes the unchecked increment activeSignersCount++.
The unchecked increment mutates the activeSignersCount state variable.
removeSigners() executes the unchecked decrement activeSignersCount--.
The unchecked decrement mutates the activeSignersCount state variable.
removeSigners() requires activeSignersCount > 1 before decrementing.
addSigners() uses the supplied signers array to update isSigner.
addSigners() pushes the supplied signers array entries into allSigners.
removeSigners() iterates over the supplied signers array.
sign() reads/writes the Script storage entry keyed by scriptAddress.
execute() uses the scriptAddress argument to look up and delegatecall the script.
cancelScript() uses the scriptAddress argument to set the Cancelled state.
getAllSigners() uses the offset argument to page through allSigners.
getAllScripts() uses the offset argument to page through scriptAddresses.
execute() reaches the delegatecall unsafe operation that runs arbitrary script code in the multisig context.
The caller-controlled scriptAddress argument is the delegatecall target.
The delegatecalled script can re-enter MultiSig and modify the scripts mapping, including its own state flags.
The delegatecall target can call back into MultiSig.execute (or other functions) since msg.sender becomes address(this).
The delegatecall with selector execute(address) dispatches to the script contract entrypoint Main0003_setupSBSigners.execute.
execute() writes script.state to Failed before and to Done after the delegatecall, leaving a reentrancy window.
sign() reads and updates the Script storage struct (signCount, signedBy, allSigners, state).
sign() pushes a newly seen script address into scriptAddresses.
sign() calls SafeMath.add for script.signCount.add(1).
cancelScript() writes ScriptState.Cancelled into the scripts mapping.
getAllScripts() reads state and signCount from the scripts mapping.
getAllScripts() iterates over scriptAddresses using the offset.
getScriptsCount() returns scriptAddresses.length.
The setup script performs external calls to add and remove signers on the StabilityBoardProxy.
The external unsafe operation targets the stabilityBoardProxy constant address.
Main0003.execute uses the stabilityBoardProxy constant to reach the multisig.
The self parameter of the setup execute() is unused.
signersToAdd local array is forwarded to the proxy addSigners call.
signersToRemove local array is forwarded to the proxy removeSigners call.
The script storage pointer is the working reference for sign().
The script storage pointer is mutated around the delegatecall in execute().
The script storage pointer is the working reference for cancelScript().
The loop index i drives the unchecked activeSignersCount increment loop in addSigners().
The loop index i drives the unchecked activeSignersCount decrement loop in removeSigners().
The uint8 index pages through allSigners in getAllSigners().
The read signer address is returned and used for the isSigner lookup.
The uint8 index pages through scriptAddresses in getAllScripts().
The read script address is used to fetch state and signCount.
SafeMath.mul operand a participates in the checked multiplication.
SafeMath.mul operand b participates in the checked multiplication.
SafeMath.div numerator a.
SafeMath.div denominator b, guarded by a b > 0 require.
SafeMath.sub minuend a.
SafeMath.sub subtrahend b, guarded by require(b <= a).
SafeMath.add first addend a.
SafeMath.add second addend b, guarded by require(c >= a).
SafeMath.roundedDiv numerator a.
SafeMath.roundedDiv denominator b, guarded by a b > 0 require.
Local product c is returned from SafeMath.mul.
Local quotient c is returned from SafeMath.div.
Local sum c is returned from SafeMath.add.
roundedDiv reaches the unchecked z++ increment.
The unchecked increment mutates the local accumulator z.
The accumulated z value is returned from SafeMath.roundedDiv.
